risks.headline: JACK contracting store base (2,115 -> ~2,100), -1.1% Q3 SSS & $1.47B debt / ($901.3M) deficit
risks.impact_mechanism: 93.0% of system units are franchised; parent SEC filings do not automatically guarantee a local franchisee lease. Under $20/hr CA fast-food wages and declining system traffic, weak unit economics risk non-renewal or default prior to 2030-2035.
risks.evidence: Q3 FY26 10-Q (S15): 4 open / 17 closed in Q3; 50-60 FY26 closures guided; franchise margin fell 39.3% -> 37.4%; dividends suspended; Sep 21, 2026 CEO succession (S16).
risks.mitigant: Verify guarantor entity + trailing 3-yr unit sales vs. $1.874M AUV immediately; prioritize Blend-and-Extend only with corporate/strong multi-unit guaranty, or exit via 1031 into investment-grade credit.

risks.headline: 2030-2035 expiration places WALT into the <5-7 yr 'institutional liquidity cliff'
risks.impact_mechanism: As remaining lease term drops below 7 years (and especially <5 years), commercial debt sizing shrinks (lenders require term > loan maturity) and 1031 exchange buyers demand +100 to +175 bps higher cap rates, wiping 15%-28% off valuation.
risks.evidence: Realty Income portfolio benchmark WALT sits at 8.5 yrs (S18); JACK May 2031 ARD notes (S15) align directly with owner expiration window.
risks.mitigant: Execute §1031 exit or tenant Blend-and-Extend (to 10-15 yrs) well before remaining WALT crosses 5 years.

risks.headline: 10Y Treasury jumped to 4.98% while Realty Income Q3 2026 acquisition cash yield fell to 6.8%
risks.impact_mechanism: Higher risk-free yields (4.98% 10Y) combined with tighter institutional NNN replacement yields (6.8%, down 50 bps from 7.3%) narrow the immediate cash-on-cash pickup of selling and exchanging, shifting the Hold-vs-Sell breakeven down toward 6.2%-6.4% going-in caps.
risks.evidence: U.S. Treasury Nov 10, 2026 (S12) & Realty Income Nov 2, 2026 8-K (S18).
risks.mitigant: Do NOT sell solely on stale 7.3% assumptions; require verified replacement quotes >= 6.8%-7.0% or sell primarily for credit/WALT/diversification protection.

risks.headline: City of LA Measure ULA imposes 4.45% (>$5.4M) or 5.95% (>=$10.9M) City tax + 0.11% County DTT
risks.impact_mechanism: A single dollar above $5.4M inside City limits triggers ~4.0% surcharge on the ENTIRE sale price (~$243k on a $5.41M sale vs. ~$30k at $5.39M), consuming years of NOI—and Nov 2026 Prop 43 rejection (57.4% No) leaves local majority-vote special transfer taxes intact.
risks.evidence: LA Office of Finance post-6/30/2026 schedule (S21); CA SOS Nov 11, 2026 canvas (S25).
risks.mitigant: Verify City vs. unincorporated jurisdiction immediately (P49); structure sub-$5.4M valuations carefully or amortize ULA via Blend-and-Extend value lift.

risks.headline: Federal (20% LTCG + 25% Sec. 1250 + 3.8% NIIT) + CA 13.30% top rate (locked by Prop 3)
risks.impact_mechanism: Selling a low-basis California asset outside IRC §1031 sacrifices 28%-35%+ of gross proceeds to taxes, forcing diversified equity/bond portfolios to earn 8.5%-10%+ pre-tax just to match untaxed net-lease cash flow.
risks.evidence: IRS Topics 409/559 (S24); CA FTB & Nov 2026 Prop 3 60.7% Yes (S25).
risks.mitigant: Use IRC §1031 (45/180-day deadlines) unless gain-to-price ratio is low (<25%) or estate step-up horizon favors holding.

risks.headline: USGS 30-yr LA earthquake odds: 60% M>=6.7 | 46% M>=7.0; CDI $1B FAIR Plan assessment
risks.impact_mechanism: An un-insured or under-insured M>=6.7 quake destroys improvements and interrupts rent; meanwhile post-Jan 2025 wildfires ($5.2B-$10.1B lost output, 16,251 structures destroyed, $1B FAIR Plan charge) drive sharp property insurance inflation and carrier withdrawals.
risks.evidence: USGS UCERF3 (S27); LA County Fire Impact PDF & CDI Release 015-2025 (S26).
risks.mitigant: Run parcel AP/Liquefaction/FHSZ checks (S27/S28), audit policy limits & loss-of-rent endorsements, and treat insurance >1.5% of value as a sell trigger.

risks.headline: LA CPI +3.7% & CSA ECI +3.9% outpace Prop 13's 2% cap and typical 1.5%-2.0% lease bumps
risks.impact_mechanism: Holding preserves a low Prop 13 tax basis (good for NNN tenant), yet flat or 1.5%/yr rent escalations lose ~2%/yr in real purchasing power while capex/repair costs escalate at ~3.7%-3.9%.
risks.evidence: BLS Sep 2026 LA CPI & ECI (S01); BOE LTA 2025/023 (S23).
risks.mitigant: Negotiate CPI-linked floors (2.5%-3.0%/yr) in any Blend-and-Extend, or rotate via §1031 into higher-growth/inflation-hedged assets.

risks.headline: AB 1228 $20.00/hr fast-food floor & +20.3% LA Energy CPI compress franchisee profitability
risks.impact_mechanism: California chains >=60 units pay $20.00/hr (vs $18.42 LA City general, $16.90 CA), pushing operators toward smaller stores, closure of underperforming pads, or tough renewal rent concessions.
risks.evidence: CA DIR FAQ (S19); LA Wages (S20); BLS Sep 2026 Energy +20.3% (S01).
risks.mitigant: Confirm store AUV covers rent comfortably (rent <=8% of gross sales) before assuming hassle-free 2030-2035 renewal.

risks.headline: LA County projected -1.77% by 2040 (-173.8k) & 57.3% City households rent-burdened
risks.impact_mechanism: Slow structural out-migration (9.81M in 2026 -> 9.64M in 2040 vs +3.09% statewide) and 11% homeownership affordability squeeze low-income QSR discretionary spending, mitigated partially by $818.5B income scale & dense Central LA daytime footfall.
risks.evidence: CA DOF P-2A Vintage 2026 (S04); Census V2025 (S03); EWDD (S06).
risks.mitigant: Evaluate 1031 diversification into growing Sunbelt/CA submarkets if parcel lacks prime infill corner traffic.

risks.headline: 1,372 sq ft drive-thru box faces 9-18 mos downtime & $150-$300/sf TI if vacated
risks.impact_mechanism: A specialty fast-food pad is narrow-purpose without a drive-thru CUP. Converting to dental/urgent care/coffee/EV or residential TOD requires substantial TI, demolition, or municipal entitlement timelines.
risks.evidence: JACK FY25 10-K prototype ~1,372 sq ft (S17); LA Metro D Line Section 1 May 2026 opening (S07).
risks.mitigant: Verify drive-thru CUP transferability & TOD density bonuses via ZIMAS immediately; maintain 12-month NOI liquidity buffer.

risks.headline: Prop 43 defeat preserves local initiative power; Prop 13 split-roll initiatives recur biennially
risks.impact_mechanism: Future commercial split-roll reassessment or expanded local transfer taxes would immediately reduce California commercial cap-rate premiums and raise NNN occupancy costs for tenants.
risks.mitigant: Treat Prop 13 permanence as conditional; weigh multi-state 1031 diversification.

risks.headline: Missing contract lease, basis, jurisdiction & appraisal prohibit single-number advice
risks.impact_mechanism: Executing either an irrevocable sale or passive hold without knowing exact expiry year, ULA applicability, basis, or tenant guaranty invites multi-hundred-thousand-dollar tax or cap-rate errors.
risks.evidence: Session P blank items P49-P56 & Q08-Q22.
risks.mitigant: Complete the 30-day Confidential Data Pack before authorizing any listing or lease amendment.
